updateReadyTitle.description: Title of the dialog shown when a new version of the app has been downloaded.

updateReadyDetail.message: A new version of Electron Fiddle has been downloaded. Restart the app to use it.
updateReadyDetail.description: Body of the dialog shown when a new version of the app has been downloaded.

restart.description: Button in the update dialog that restarts the app to install the update.

later.description: Button in the update dialog that closes it; the update installs on the next launch.

versionBlockedMessage.message: This version of Electron Fiddle can no longer be used
versionBlockedMessage.description: Blocking notice shown at startup when this app version has been withdrawn. The app quits after it.

versionBlockedDetail.message: Download the latest version to keep using Electron Fiddle.
versionBlockedDetail.description: Body of the blocking notice for a withdrawn version, used when the server gives no message of its own.

downloadLatest.description: Button in the withdrawn-version notice that opens the download page, then quits.

moveMessage.message: Move Electron Fiddle to the Applications folder?
moveMessage.description: macOS first-run question, shown when the app runs from outside /Applications.

moveDetail.message: Updates install reliably only when the app is in the Applications folder.
moveDetail.description: macOS first-run explanation under the move-to-Applications question.

moveButton.description: Button that moves the app into /Applications and relaunches it.

dontMove.description: Button that keeps the app where it is.

crashConsentMessage.message: A window crashed. Send a crash report?
crashConsentMessage.description: Question shown after an app window crashed natively, before a crash dump is uploaded.

crashConsentDetail.message: The report includes a snapshot of the crashed window's memory, which may contain the code you had open. It helps the Electron Fiddle team fix the crash.
crashConsentDetail.description: Explains what a native crash report contains, so the user can decide whether to send it.

sendReport.description: Button that uploads the crash report.

dontSend.description: Button that discards the crash report.

aboutVersion.description: Version line in the About panel on Windows and Linux. {{version}} is the app version, {{electron}} the Electron version, e.g. 1.0.0 (Electron 44.3.0).

aboutCopyright.description: Copyright line in the About panel. Keep the © sign.

resetPrivacyMessage.description: Confirmation before resetting the macOS privacy permissions given to the app.

resetPrivacyDetail.message: Electron Fiddle and the fiddles it runs lose access to the camera, microphone, contacts and other protected data. Fiddles run as the standard Electron app, so other apps running on a plain Electron download lose access too. macOS asks again the next time they need it.
resetPrivacyDetail.description: Detail of the reset privacy permissions confirmation.

resetPrivacyButton.description: Button that confirms resetting the privacy permissions.

resetPrivacyFailed.message: The privacy permissions couldn't be reset.
resetPrivacyFailed.description: Error when macOS's tccutil command fails.
